title: Sato 1999: L4-L5 IDP lying prone, 8 healthy subjects

quantity.name: IDP
quantity.definition: absolute in vivo intradiscal pressure in the nucleus (MPa), peak/plateau value for the posture

source.authors: Sato K, Kikuchi S, Yonezawa T
source.sample: 8 healthy subjects (men); 8 healthy volunteers without back problems (plus 28 patients not used here), L4-L5

protocol.summary: Needle transducer in the L4-L5 nucleus of 8 healthy volunteers; lying prone (Sato 1999 Table 2).
how_to_simulate: Scale the model to the Sato cohort mean (protocol.subject_model: male, 24.5 y, 173.4 cm, 72.6 kg) - or to each subject in per_subject for a per-subject comparison
Output: L4-L5 compression F and L4-L5 intersegmental rotation th relative to upright standing
Convert with Ghezelbash 2016 Eq. 6: P = F / A, A = 1585 mm2 (cohort mean) or the subject's own area; compare with data[0].mean

subject_model.sex: male (Bruno 2015 J Biomech Eng Table 3: '8M'; Ghezelbash lab validation targets: male); V05 Table 2 prints '-' (sex not given)
subject_model.source: Means computed here from the 8 per-subject rows of Dreischarf 2016 (V05) Table 2 (age, body weight, height, disc area; BMI column re-computed and matches). The Ghezelbash lab validation targets (subjects.sato) uses 25 y, 174 cm, 73 kg, 1590 (1340-1890) mm2 (Fasser 2021 Suppl. Table S1, Bruno 2015 Table 3: BM 73 kg, HT 174 cm, ages 22-29) - consistent except the weight range (targets 60-96 kg; V05 max 94 kg).
subject_model.per_subject_source: V05 Table 2 p.836 (page image; the published table is typeset with cells split across lines - re-assembled here and checked: BMI = weight/height^2 and the V05 compression = 0.66 x IDP x area reproduce every row within rounding).

protocol.idp_conversion: IDP = -1.556e-2 + 1.255 P + 1.243e-2 th + 3.988e-2 P^2 - 1.212e-2 P th + 1.669e-3 th^2 (MPa), P = F_compression / A_disc (MPa = N/mm2), th = L4-L5 intersegmental flexion from upright standing (deg, + flexion). Source: Ghezelbash et al. 2016 Biomech Model Mechanobiol 15:1699, Eq. 6 (U01 p.10; quadratic fit to the Shirazi-Adl 2006 L4-L5 FE model, R2 0.999, RMSE 0.025 MPa; derived with that model's disc area 1455 mm2, applied with the subject's own area); used again as Eq. 1-2 in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 J Biomech 102:109550 and in the Ghezelbash lab MSK validation. Sensitivity alternative: classical Nachemson factor IDP = F / (0.66 A) (Bruno et al. 2015 J Biomech Eng Eq. 2; Dreischarf 2016 V05 uses F = 0.66 IDP A).
protocol.notes: Lying pressure is mostly disc swelling pressure; compression-driven models underpredict it.

data.src: Sato 1999 Table 2, vertical pressure, mean +/- SD (primary)

extraction.from: Sato K, Kikuchi S, Yonezawa T. Spine 1999;24:2468-2474, Table 2 (vertical pressure V; horizontal H differs by <= 2%)
extraction.check_notes: Checked against the primary paper (Sato 1999 Spine 24:2468, Table 2) on 2026-11-12; table means recomputed from the 8 rows (within 1 kPa).

pass_rule.rule: pass if |model - measured| <= max(SD or half-range, 0.26 x measured); pooled over all L4-L5 tasks R2 >= 0.78 with slope 95% CI containing 1 and intercept CI containing 0
pass_rule.source: Ghezelbash lab validation targets tolerance_policy.idp_task / idp_aggregate (CV_pool 0.26 = pooled between-subject CV of Sato 1999's 8 healthy subjects)
